_README.what_this_is: Bitwise (IEEE-754 hex) reference values for the STATIC-source transport path, consumed by tests/test_time_resolved_pk.py. Its purpose is to prove that the time-resolved-source refactor did not change static-source behaviour. Its value depends on nobody quietly regenerating it to make their own change pass, so every re-pin is recorded below, in full, with the superseded values kept.
_README.how_to_regenerate: Deliberately NOT scripted. Re-pinning must cost someone real work and a written justification. Rebuild each case by hand from _REFERENCE_CASES in tests/test_time_resolved_pk.py, record float.hex() of every quantity, and add a _repin_history entry stating the cause, the exact set of values that moved, and why the movement is the predicted one rather than a regression.

_repin_history.cause: UNITS FIX in tmesim/physics/pressure.py. The tumour-occupancy smoothing constant _TUMOR_SIGMA = 5.0 was documented as 'grid cells' and passed straight to scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter, whose sigma is in PIXELS. Because the smoothed field phi sets both the vessel-leak gain and the lymphatic suppression, that made it a MODEL parameter that silently tracked the mesh: 40 um at dx=8, 60 at dx=12, 75 at dx=15, 400 at dx=80. Refining the grid redefined the model, so no IFP convergence study could ever converge. It is now _TUMOR_SIGMA_UM = 60.0, a physical length converted to pixels at the point of use.
_repin_history.why_the_new_values_are_right_and_not_mer: The old values encode a model whose smoothing length was an artefact of the mesh. At dx=15 the old model smoothed over 75 um and at dx=80 over 400 um; both now smooth over 60 um, the same physical length the production grid always used. The new numbers are the SAME model these cases were always meant to be running, evaluated on their own grids.
_repin_history.predicted_and_observed_failure_pattern: phi reaches a transport result only through the Darcy velocity v = -K grad p, so the change can bite ONLY when convection is on. Observed exactly: default_1dose, weak_1dose, weak_3dose (dx=15, convection=True) and real_xenium_dx80_tmz_3dose (dx=80, convection=True) moved; weak_10dose_noconv (convection=False) and solver_flat (raw solver, no IFP at all) are byte-for-byte unchanged and were NOT regenerated. Movement in the transport sums is 1-3 ULP; plasma_mean, a pure-PK quantity with no spatial dependence, is unchanged in every case.
_repin_history.production_grid_is_unaffected: 60.0/12.0 == 5.0 exactly in IEEE-754, so at the production grid dx = 12 um gaussian_filter receives a bit-identical argument. Verified on the real Xenium GBM section: the solved IFP field, the Darcy velocity, the 250 um display coarse-grain and all 5 exported contours hash identically before and after, and the published landing figures reproduce (raw max 12.93283 mmHg, raw tissue mean 0.128387 mmHg, displayed max 0.72608 mmHg). The production_xenium_dx12_tmz_3dose entry added in this same commit was generated BEFORE the fix and verified unchanged AFTER it, so it pins that invariance permanently.
_repin_history.guard_strengthened_in_the_same_commit: Before this re-pin the file pinned dx = 15 and dx = 80 only — the production grid dx = 12 had no bitwise pin at all. production_xenium_dx12_tmz_3dose now covers it, at both the IFP-solver level and end-to-end through the engine with convection ON.

_repin_history.cause: THE TWO-ROUTE TRANSPORT MODEL BECAME THE SHIPPING DEFAULT (results/two_route_promotion.md). compile_drug.build_profile now multiplies the ECM-hindered interstitial D by a two-route cell factor -- cells as PERMEABLE inclusions (Maxwell 1873, generalised to a finite interfacial conductance by Hasselman & Johnson 1987), with the membrane permeability computed from logP and hydrogen-bond donor count. Temozolomide's compiled diffusivity went 277.985 -> 42.4245 um^2/s (factor 0.15261, of which the transcellular route contributes 1.0097x and the impermeable-cell Maxwell term the rest). Doxorubicin's went 184.7486 -> 27.9256, and because the single perivascular-sink constant alpha is fitted in closed form from L = sqrt(D_eff/k_eff) against the SAME measured 64.92 um Primeau anchor, alpha went 148.60815765445545 -> 22.223477711172563. Both cases below use a COMPILED, alpha-calibrated temozolomide, so both had to move.
_repin_history.why_the_new_values_are_right_and_not_mer: The old values encode a diffusivity law whose only solute input was molecular weight. That law was scored blind against 71 compounds measured by one method in one cell line (Pruijn 2008, doi:10.1071/CH08240) and REFUTED: R^2 = 0.022, 2.3x of a measured 29.7x spread, and flat BY CONSTRUCTION at matched molecular weight where the measurement moves 3.7-3.8x (results/diffusivity_falsification.md). The law now in force scores R^2 = 0.718 on the same 71 compounds, blind and unfitted, with 99 % of compounds within 3x of measurement and a geometric bias of 1.03x, and it brings the engine's dimensionless multicellular-layer hindrance factor inside its measured band for the first time (1.77-fold -> 10.33-fold against a measured 12-fold, PMID 9806526) -- a scorecard verdict that moved FAIL -> PASS. These cases are now running a transport coefficient that has been tested against external measurement and largely agrees with it, rather than one that had been tested and did not. THE NEW VALUES ARE STILL NOT CORRECT ABSOLUTE PREDICTIONS and nothing here should be read as claiming they are; see the entry below.
_repin_history.predicted_and_observed_failure_pattern: Only a case whose drug comes from the molecular COMPILE can move. Observed exactly: real_xenium_dx80_tmz_3dose and production_xenium_dx12_tmz_3dose (both use calibrated_drugparams('temozolomide')) moved and were regenerated; default_1dose, weak_1dose, weak_3dose, weak_10dose_noconv and solver_flat all use hand-built DrugParams literals with no compile in the path and are byte-for-byte unchanged; and test_production_dx12_ifp_solve_matches_stored_reference_bitwise, which solves the pressure field and has no drug in it at all, passed untouched. Within the two cases that moved, plasma_mean -- a pure-PK quantity with no spatial dependence and no diffusivity in it -- is BIT-IDENTICAL, which is the positive control on the mechanism.
_repin_history.the_magnitudes_are_a_finding_not_a_footn: These are not ULP-level movements like the 2026-08-12 re-pin. kill_fraction goes 0.023980 -> 0.066227 at dx = 12 (2.76x) and 0.026373 -> 0.139384 at dx = 80 (5.29x); auc_sum rises by the same order. THE DIRECTION IS THE SURPRISE AND IT IS WORTH UNDERSTANDING: diffusivity FELL 6.6x, yet exposure ROSE. The reason is that the Primeau anchor pins the RATIO D/k, so the fitted loss rate k = clearance + alpha*binding fell with D (alpha 148.61 -> 22.22). A weaker sink leaves far more drug in tissue even though it spreads more slowly. results/cellular_exclusion.md sec. 6 predicted exactly this: the p99-normalised ratio the breast panel scores is immune to a common-mode exposure change -- and 0 of 12 of those verdicts moved -- while threshold statistics such as kill fraction and IC50 coverage are NOT. Anyone quoting an absolute kill_fraction from a run predating 2026-08-13 is quoting a number that has moved by 3-5x, and absolute kill fraction was already documented as a non-defensible output for independent reasons.

_superseded_2026-08-13_mw_only_diffusivi._what: The values these two cases produced under the MOLECULAR-WEIGHT-ONLY diffusivity model, i.e. every static-source reference published before results/two_route_promotion.md. Kept verbatim. Reproduce them exactly by passing two_route=False to compile_drug.build_profile, which is asserted bitwise in tests/test_two_route.py::TestShippingDefault::test_the_superseded_value_is_still_exactly_recoverable.

_superseded_2026-08-12_grid_cell_tumor_s._note: The values these four cases held BEFORE the 2026-08-12 units fix. They encode the GRID-CELL tumour-sigma model, in which the physical smoothing length was 5.0 * dx um (75 um at dx=15, 400 um at dx=80) instead of a fixed 60 um. Kept so a reader can see exactly what moved. NOT asserted by any test; do not restore them without restoring the defect.

production_xenium_dx12_tmz_3dose._note: PRODUCTION-GRID pin, added 2026-08-12 alongside the tumour-sigma units fix. The real Xenium GBM section at dx = 12 um -- the grid every shipped result and the landing asset are computed on -- previously had NO bitwise pin. Convection is ON, so this exercises the Darcy velocity path that the units fix touches. These values were generated BEFORE the fix and verified identical AFTER it, so the entry pins the claim that dx = 12 is the exact fixed point of the change.
